messages.speaker: client
messages.text: I am frustrated. Notifications settings crashes every time I open it. This is my third attempt. Please help with that crash.

messages.speaker: operator
messages.text: Hello, I'm Mira. I've opened technical ticket T-233 specifically for the crash when opening Notifications settings. Can I help with anything else? Goodbye!

references.text: This fictional app has a Notifications settings screen. A repeatable crash on that screen should be raised as a technical ticket. Markets > Bonds is bond navigation and does not fix Notifications crashes. Generic technical support requires no identity check.
references.provenance: Fictional diagnostic policy, not Freedom product documentation

expectations.rationale: Specific corrective action responds to the actual crash; polite or generic sympathetic wording plus unrelated instructions does not.
A relevant technical next step versus an unrelated answer that does not address the stated request.
